craft_notes: Sthāyin: oracle-joy. Close: form. Rejected: 'prophesies' — killed: tells kept.

lines: Asked, he tells the past and future — ere three hours pass,

reads_against.argmap: Asked, he tells even past and future; within a watch what meant, god-form voicing.
c1_essence: Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
